# Dreamweaver spirit

- **Status:** ⚠️ Unverified
- **Mechanic tags:** pact-spirit, penetration

## Notes / caveats / open questions

Shipped in the engine; not yet verified in-game. "Damage Penetrates N% Resistance" → {type}_pen; stacking pen → elemental_hit_pen_stacks condition.

## Implementation (engine model)

Resolved by the server's freeform-mod parser (`server._parse_custom_mod_text` / `_resolve_effect_modifiers`), not a bespoke module. Flat lines `Damage Penetrates N% <Type> Resistance` map to the corresponding pen stat key: `elemental_pen`, `fire_pen`/`cold_pen`/`lightning_pen`, or `erosion_pen` (amount = N/100). On-hit stacking lines (`+N% Elemental Resistance Penetration when hitting … stacking up to M times`) resolve to a PER-STACK `elemental_pen` carrying `condition {key: elemental_hit_pen_stacks, op: per, divisor: 1}`, so total pen = per-stack × stack count; the `elemental_hit_pen_stacks` numeric condition defaults to its max (full uptime, user-adjustable). Pen is deducted from the target's effective resist in `offense.py::_target_effective`/`_target_mitigation`; `elemental_pen` excludes erosion. `backend/tests/test_dreamweaver.py` asserts every Dreamweaver line resolves (no NYI).
